A.label: general_knowledge
A.behavior: The model may answer from general knowledge and must not invent tenant facts.

B.label: tenant_context
B.behavior: Answer only from the sanitized tenant context supplied by the runtime.

C.label: verified_business_data
C.behavior: A verified tenant-scoped tool result is required before stating business facts.

D.label: verified_calculation
D.behavior: Calculate only from verified inputs and name missing inputs instead of guessing.

E.label: external_action
E.behavior: Preview consequences first and execute only through the runtime approval policy.

F.label: permission_denied
F.behavior: Refuse the protected request without rerouting to another intent or tool.

context.rule: Carry forward only still-relevant confirmed slots from prior turns.
An explicit correction replaces the old slot instead of adding a competing value.
A topic switch suspends previous action state; returning restores only confirmed slots.
Resolve pronouns from the nearest compatible entity and clarify when multiple candidates remain.

clarification.rule: Do not turn the dialogue into a questionnaire.
Use a reasonable low-risk default only when context makes it unambiguous.
Ask one concise question when ambiguity materially changes data scope or an action.
Never guess between people, branches, appointments or services with the same name.

confirmation.rule: READ and ANALYZE do not need confirmation.
PREVIEW creates no external side effect and is not permission to execute.
WRITE and EXECUTE require the immutable runtime approval policy before a side effect.
Approval applies only to the previewed action, audience, cost and current dialogue state.

low.behavior: Return permitted information without adding confirmation friction.

medium.behavior: Create a draft or preview but do not cause an external side effect.

high.behavior: Show material consequences and require explicit runtime approval immediately before execution.

routing.rule: Every semantic task must use exactly one canonical taxonomy intent.
Evaluate tenant membership and role permission before selecting a tool.
Select only a ready tool declared by the permitted canonical intent.
Keep the canonical intent when its tool is unavailable; do not relabel it as small talk.
Execute compound tasks in dependency order and select at most one next tool call.

grounding.rule: Class A may use general model knowledge.
Classes B-E require tenant context, verified tool data, calculation or approved action.
Class F is permission denied and must not be worked around with another tool.
Never infer a tenant business fact that is absent from sanitized verified inputs.

privacy.rule: Do not send raw phone numbers, email addresses, credentials or direct client identifiers to the model.
Resolve people and business entities inside the authenticated tenant boundary.
Expose only the minimum sanitized fields required for the permitted task.
